[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-11y[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Service host and Services tab[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every SASE background process on a machine — the AXE scheduler, the[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]mobile gateway, plugin daemons like the Telegram receiver, user [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]daemons, and `!` background commands — is owned by one `sase [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]service` host that a platform unit (systemd user unit on Linux, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]launchd LaunchAgent on macOS) starts at boot/login, controlled from[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]one `sase service` CLI and one Services tab, with every legacy [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]supervision path retired as its replacement lands.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]10[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Cgroup escape helper for detached work[/bold #D7AFFF]                        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]detach-scope[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]detach-scope: add a detach_scope helper that lets agents, detached [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]procs, monitors/gates, and gateway bridges escape the service unit's [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]cgroup (systemd-run scope on Linux, setsid on macOS), apply it at every [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]detach point, and rename src/sase/procs/service.py.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]sase-core service foundations[/bold #D7AFFF]                                 [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]core-service[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core-service: add the Rust-side service.procs config composer, the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]proc-wire service block and query field, the retention exemption, the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]locked service state store with boot-scoped stops, the status wire, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the pure restart-decision function, plus PyO3 bindings and Python [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]facades.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Extract the shared child-supervision library[/bold #D7AFFF]                  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]supervision-lib[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]supervision-lib: extract the AXE orchestrator's child-supervision logic [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF](backoff, crash-loop detection, TERM->KILL, bounded log pump) into a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]shared module and re-use it from the orchestrator with no behavior [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]change.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Service host runtime and CLI[/bold #D7AFFF]                                  [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]service-host[dim] · [dim][/dim]after detach-scope, core-service, supervision-lib[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]service-host: implement the sase service host runtime and the sase [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]service / sase service proc / sase scheduler CLI behind a new [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]service_host beta flag, with the scheduler builtin, orchestrator [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]handover, and the detached no-unit fallback.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Platform units and init integration[/bold #D7AFFF]                           [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]platform-units[dim] · [dim][/dim]after service-host[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]platform-units: add sase service init/uninstall with systemd and launchd[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]unit writers, the captured host environment file, legacy-unit detection,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]linger and provider-CLI checks, and the machine-scoped sase init step [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]prompted once under --all.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Gateway builtin and Telegram plugin migration[/bold #D7AFFF]                 [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]gateway-telegram[dim] · [dim][/dim]after service-host[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]gateway-telegram: add the gateway builtin launcher and sase mobile [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]gateway pair, default the gateway off in core config, and migrate the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sase-telegram receiver to a plugin-declared service proc while retiring [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the rearm tick and core's origin-string hack.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Services tab in the TUI[/bold #D7AFFF]                                       [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]services-tab[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core-service, service-host[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]services-tab: rename the AXE tab display label to Services, render [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]service-proc nodes with routine/job nodes nested under the Scheduler [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]node, add start/stop/enable/disable keys and the host status line, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]replace the footer pill, and wire gear exclusion plus the configurable [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]-service Procs default query.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Migrate background commands to oneshot service procs[/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]oneshots[dim] · [dim][/dim]after service-host, services-tab[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]oneshots: move the ! background-command flow onto the durable proc store[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  9 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Live migration on athena and apollo[/bold #D7AFFF]                           [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]rollout[dim] · [dim][/dim]after platform-units, gateway-telegram[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]rollout: install the platform unit on both machines, migrate the [/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  10 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Sunset legacy paths, docs, and glossary[/bold #D7AFFF]                      [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
